meta.title: SAP PR Sync Mode (integration.sap.pr.sync_mode) = Bidirectional
gaps: Set integration.sap.pr.sync_mode to Bidirectional as a Tenant Admin
Configure PR synchronization as Real-time or scheduled Batch
Observe and verify bidirectional SAP-to-Procol and Procol-to-SAP Purchase Requisition data flow
Verify the behavior differs from the default Push (SAP → Procol) mode
Configure or verify conflict resolution logic required by Bidirectional mode
Verify the stated data freshness and system-load impact
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set integration.sap.pr.sync_mode to Bidirectional as a Tenant Admin; Configure PR synchronization as Real-time or scheduled Batch; Observe and verify bidirectional SAP-to-Procol and Procol-to-SAP Purchase Requisition data flow; Verify the behavior differs from the default Push (SAP → Procol) mode; Configure or verify conflict resolution logic required by Bidirectional mode; Verify the stated data freshness and system-load impact

args.need: sign in as a Tenant Admin on an Enterprise tenant, set SAP PR Sync Mode to Bidirectional, configure Real-time and scheduled Batch PR sync modes, and verify SAP and Procol Purchase Requisition data flows bidirectionally with conflict resolution configured

steps.note: The catalog cannot access tenant administration settings, SAP integration controls, another system, or conflict-resolution configuration.
Closest available PR-related navigation after the missing integration setup; this can only show Procol's Purchase Requisitions screen and cannot verify SAP synchronization.
